rules.accentFill: Anything filled with accent.base (buttons, badges, unread counts) draws its text and glyphs in accent.on (#2A1600, 9.5:1). Never white: white on accent is 1.8:1.
rules.textContrast: Every text colour passes WCAG AA on ink 900, 800, 700 and 600 (lowest: tertiary on ink 600, 4.8:1).
rules.heroFrame: Game art is never badged. It sits in a Playscribe frame: inset card, book-silhouette bottom edge dipping 16pt to the centre, lit inner edge (1.5pt vellum 100 at 60%, inset, decorative, never a focus ring), NEW CHAPTER + v1.1 chip, with Literata/Instrument Sans labels below on ink. No open-device outer cover exists on iPhone Duo.

type.display: Literata (OFL). Serif (Literata 24pt optical cut) is for screen titles, game names and pull quotes. Update titles and update names use Instrument Sans Bold for legibility (Terry, 2 Nov 2026: big serif titles were hard to read). The 72pt cut is only for the outlined logo and wordmark, never live text.
type.rule: Terry, 2 Nov 2026: fonts are identical in every pose and for every game. Only these tokens, never Font.custom, .system or game-specific fonts in views.
